value.answer: I'm glad you reached out, and it makes sense to want someone to talk to. The free option is Ontario Structured Psychotherapy. It gives free, publicly funded CBT to adults in Ontario with depression or anxiety. You don't need an Ontario health card or a family doctor, and you can refer yourself at ontariohealth.ca/osp, where you find your local network and fill in the referral form. Sessions can be online, by phone or in person. If you'd rather pay privately, the Affordable Therapy Network has a directory of over 500 therapists, mostly in Toronto or online, and Get Reconnected has sessions with supervised student interns for $45 each. Those listings are a bit old, so prices may have changed.
